# Rok Retar — Mobile Engineer

> Rok Retar is a mobile engineer specializing in Android and Kotlin Multiplatform. This site showcases projects, engineering articles, and professional experience. The site itself is built natively in Kotlin with Kobweb.

## About
Rok Retar engineers Android and Kotlin Multiplatform systems, including migrating a company's iOS app to shared Kotlin. Specializations include KMP migrations, native architecture, Jetpack Compose, and Kobweb.
